name: SnowTrampled
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.398

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven snow_01 (boot-trodden snow), 2x2, levelled, then height-blended with a shifted copy of itself under a 4 m mask so the 2 m period is broken; prints still run along V and the 2 m period is broken
known_weaknesses: prints run along V only (a turned copy shades differently under a low sun, so the self-blend is shift-only); modern boot treads are visible under 1 m; 1.95 mm per pixel
